jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Last Mile Platform Services, SDE
jobs.exp_hint: - 3+ years of non-internship professional software deve
jobs.description:
Amazon's Last Mile Technology team brings new technology to the hardest problems in last mile delivery. We want a top-in-class experience, not only for the customer receiving a package but also for the transporters who deliver millions of them every day. Real innovation in this space is part of who we are.
How Amazon speaks to its transporters is one of the most critical systems in Last Mile. The Rabbit Communications Platform owns every surface Amazon uses to reach a Delivery Partner, Delivery Associate or Flex driver: Newsfeed, push notifications, in-app messaging, automated calls and automated customer contact. It runs on Android, iOS and wearables, worldwide. When a severe-weather shelter-in-place directive has to reach a driver in their own language, or a customer's gate code needs to travel from one delivery to the next, those journeys run on what we build. And for the driver, every one of them ends on the phone in their hand.
We are looking for talented Android and iOS Software Development Engineers to design and build the client side of these mission-critical systems. You will work on hard problems at fleet scale, on devices that are moving, often offline and running low on battery, and you will have the autonomy to deliver impactful solutions. You will develop and operate tier-1 communication surfaces in native Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift).
You will learn how to build server-driven, self-service client surfaces that take app releases off the critical path for communications. You'll design driver-safe interaction patterns for people who are behind the wheel or walking to a door. You'll engineer offline-first sync and message delivery across 1-to-N broadcast and 1-to-1 push. You'll internationalize and localize an app that runs in dozens of languages, including right-to-left scripts, across global markets. You'll extend these experiences to wearables. And you'll hold the crash-free rate, startup latency, battery, data-usage and accessibility standards…

Amazon’s Selection Monitoring team is responsible for making the biggest catalog on the planet even bigger. Our systems process billions of products to algorithmically find products not already sold on Amazon and programmatically add them to the Amazon catalog. We apply parallel processing, machine learning and deep learning algorithms to evaluate products and brands in order to identify and prioritize products and brands to be added to Amazon’s catalog. The datasets produced by our team are used by teams across Amazon to improve: product information, search and discoverability, pricing, and delivery experience. Our work involves building state-of-the-art Information Retrieval (IR) systems to mine the web and automatically create structured entities from un-structure/semi-structured data. We constantly stretch the boundaries of large scale distributed systems, Elastic Computing, Big Data, and SOA technologies to tackle challenges at Amazon’s global scale.
Come join us in our journey to make everything – and yes, we do mean *everything* – that anyone wants to buy, available on Amazon!

jobs.description:
Come build the future with us! In Payments Security (PaySec), we protect the foundational systems and products that allow Amazon to accept payments for all goods, content, and services that people buy at Amazon and around the world. International Emerging Stores Payments (IESP) brings Amazon's payments products to customers in some of the fastest-growing markets in the world, across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Asia Pacific (APAC) including India, and South America. These markets run on real-time payment rails such as UPI, on local wallets, cards, bill payments, and lending products, and on regulatory regimes that differ from one country to the next. Every one of those transactions depends on customer trust, and IESP Payments Security exists to earn and keep it.

We are part of Amazon's broader Stores Security organization, responsible for protecting Amazon's global information assets. We partner with Payments builder teams to make applications and infrastructure secure-by-design from concept to launch and into continuous operations, and we build the mechanisms, guardrails, and automation that let thousands of engineers do the right thing by default.
As a software engineer on IESP Payments Security, you will build the software that makes security automatic for Amazon's payments businesses in MENA, APAC including India, and South America. Imagine writing the code that stops a vulnerability before it is merged, or an AI agent that scans hundreds of production applications and finds payment data stored where it should not be.
You will work on three kinds of problems. First, controls-as-code: security rules and guardrails that run on every code change, including code written with AI assistance. We bridge embedded hardware and cloud platforms to enable low-latency, reliable, and scalable intelligence at the edge, powering the in-vehicle experiences that keep drivers safe and deliveries efficient.
We are building the next generation of smart delivery vehicles, both traditional and electric, combining IoT technologies, real-time data streams, and machine learning to deliver faster, safer, and better.
Key job responsibilities
* On-Device Applications: Design and develop applications that power in-vehicle experiences, improve safety, and enhance delivery efficiency across multiple device platforms
